instruction: Check the document on the desktop for the list of recommended plugins and install only the first three extensions from the Chrome Web Store.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing only the first 3 extensions from the document list (Zoom Chrome Extension, Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader, React Developer Tools). Fixed metric function to check exact match instead of subset.
metadata.fix_applied: Created custom metric function that verifies exact match of installed extensions (filters out default Chrome extensions, then checks set equality)

llm_judge_reasons: Metric function correctly implements exact match verification using set equality (line 51 in custom chrome.py:51), which verifies both: (1) all expected extensions are installed AND (2) no extra extensions are installed

Metric correctly filters out default Chrome extensions (Chrome Web Store, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs Offline) before comparison to avoid false positives (custom chrome.py:31-43)
Postconfig correctly relaunches Chrome to ensure extension state is persisted and accessible for verification

Parameter handling is CORRECT: metric accesses expected['expected'] where expected parameter receives the rules dict {'expected': [...]} from get_rule, so expected['expected'] correctly retrieves the extension list

Complete requirement coverage: evaluator verifies all aspects of the instruction (correct extensions installed, no extra extensions)
